verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms llms.txt is served at https://ryzenai.docs.amd.com/llms.txt with HTTP 200, directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented docs for Ryzen AI. However, the .md per-page docs format returns 404, indicating the agent-friendly doc surface is limited to the single llms.txt file rather than a broader per-page markdown ecosystem. Missing for 10: no evidence of comprehensive per-page markdown/agent docs beyond the single llms.txt, no independent corroboration of llms.txt content quality or completeness.
